messages:
Noah (People Ops): Threading the follow-up from the all-hands Q&A about hybrid schedules, travel, and offsite logistics. Short answers + links. Reply here for edge cases.
Riya (Facilities): Will we change hoteling to shorter blocks? Several people asked for morning/afternoon slots.
Noah (People Ops): Yes 12 well pilot morning/afternoon blocks starting June 7 and evaluate. Facilities will publish instructions on the intranet.
Priam (CTO): For teams doing deep work sprints, can the company cover a week-long co-location space (offsite) beyond the quarterly all-hands? Whats the process?
Marta (Finance): We have a "team co-location" fund that covers up to $1,000 per approved week for space + local transport. Submit the co-locate request form at https://intranet.redwood/co-locate with manager sign-off 3 weeks before.
Lina (Sales): If partners join an offsite session, how do we tag expenses? Want to avoid misclassifying.
Marta (Finance): Partners = client entertainment. Use the "client-entertainment" tag and attach purpose/attendee list. Internal-only = "team-offsite" tag. We'll add both tags to Expensify this week.
access-bot: Reminder: if visiting the data center for an on-site ops shift, request temporary access at least 72h prior: https://intranet.redwood/access-request
Priam (CTO): Are there travel supports for sudden ops trips (same-week)? Sometimes we need quick trips for incidents.
Noah (People Ops): Emergency ops travel allowed. Use the expediting form and get your manager to approve within 48h post-trip. Finance will fast-track reimbursements for incident work.
Riya (Facilities): Any rules for reserving conference rooms for multi-day workshops? We had conflicts last quarter.
Noah (People Ops): Use the workshop form and mark "multi-day". Facilities will grant priority booking for approved workshops and hold adjacent rooms for balance. Submit at least 10 business days prior.
hoteling-bot: Hoteling update: pilot half-day slots live June 7. Book at /hoteling. Business-travel tag available for same-day bookings.
Lina (Sales): Is there a cap for meals during multi-day offsites? Some teams went over budget last time.
Marta (Finance): Offsite meal guideline: $70/day domestic, $100/day international per person as a guide. Exceptions require manager + Finance pre-approval.
Priam (CTO): For hiring remote-first engineers who will visit for ramp/onboarding, does Redwood cover those visits? How many nights?
Noah (People Ops): Yes 12 first-time onboarding visits covered up to 3 nights (flight + hotel). Hiring team arranges booking via travel@redwood. Add "onboarding" in the travel form.
Lina (Sales): Can employees expense coworking when traveling for customers and need a quiet place?
Marta (Finance): Coworking reimbursable with manager pre-approval up to $50/day. Mark as "coworking" in Expensify and include city + reason.
Priam (CTO): Any changes to required in-office days for roles that need occasional hardware access?
Noah (People Ops): Roles needing hardware/data-center access must list required on-site days on the job posting. Managers coordinate additional travel support for those folks.
Riya (Facilities): Parking passes question: will we still offer monthly parking at HQ for people who commute occasionally?
Noah (People Ops): Monthly parking remains limited. For occasional commutes, submit a daily parking request via facilities@redwood and well provide visitor passes where available.
Priam (CTO): Health/safety question for international offsites  any vaccine or insurance requirements?
Noah (People Ops): People traveling internationally on company business must have travel insurance (company can reimburse policy cost if purchased specifically for trip) and follow any host-country entry rules. People Ops will send a checklist for international travel next week.
Marta (Finance): Action items recap: 1) Finance to add Expensify tags (team-offsite, client-entertainment, coworking) by June 1; 2) People Ops to publish international travel checklist + organizer template by May 25; 3) Facilities to enable half-day hoteling pilot June 7 and update booking UI. We'll post links when live.
Lina (Sales): Thanks 44d super clear.
Priam (CTO): Nice 44d appreciate the checklist.
Noah (People Ops): If any special cases (visa costs, dependent-care, or ADA accommodations), DM me directly. I'll update this thread when things go live. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
